node.statement: From lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, eta_A>0 and epsilon_E>0, while C_theta=12*(sqrt(2)-1)>0, C_A=20+(211/8)*C_theta>0, rho_theta=1/8>0, and bar_C_E=max{1,C_E}>=1. Expanding (1.1)-(1.5) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting in displayed order, every coefficient used as a reciprocal denominator is positive and every radius is a finite minimum of positive quantities; in particular rho_2, rho_DeltaUpsilon, rho_mult, and rho_UpsilonDelta are positive. Equation (1.7) defines rho_fac as the minimum of exactly these four positive numbers, hence rho_fac>0.
